=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text pct "%"
text hexd "0123456789ABCDEF"
text u1 "http://foo bar/"
text u2 "mailto:joe@example.com?subject=a&b c~d_e.f-g"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitc writes one byte
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 0
put b 0 c
emit b
end
note keep says whether c is written as itself: letters and digits always, - . _ ~ only in the
note RFC 3986 variant (rfc true); every other byte becomes % and two upper-case hex digits
fn keep c uchar rfc bool to bool
if or or and ge c 48 le c 57 and ge c 65 le c 90 and ge c 97 le c 122
ret true
end
if and rfc or or eq c 45 eq c 46 or eq c 95 eq c 126
ret true
end
ret false
end
fn enc a view uchar * rfc bool to void
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if keep c rfc
emitc c
else
emit pct
emitc get hexd shr c 4
emitc get hexd and c 15
end
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
enc u1 false
enc u1 true
enc u2 false
enc u2 true
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
http%3A%2F%2Ffoo%20bar%2F
http%3A%2F%2Ffoo%20bar%2F
mailto%3Ajoe%40example%2Ecom%3Fsubject%3Da%26b%20c%7Ed%5Fe%2Ef%2Dg
mailto%3Ajoe%40example.com%3Fsubject%3Da%26b%20c~d_e.f-g
</pre>
